svg.title: Permanganate oxidative alkene cleavage: complete teaching sequence

g.title: Permanganate oxidative alkene cleavage: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
g.desc: CH3CH=CHCH3 + MnO4− → Cyclic manganate-derived adduct. Oxidant addition introduces two C–O linkages through a cyclic manganese-containing model; manganese speciation is not fixed by a four-digit code.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.

g.title: Permanganate oxidative alkene cleavage: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
g.desc: Manganate-derived adduct + water → CH3CH(OH)CH(OH)CH3 + reduced Mn species. Hydrolysis gives a vicinal-diol description at teaching resolution; its accumulation is not required under forcing conditions.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Hydrolysis gives a vicinal-diol description at teaching resolution; its accumulation is not required under forcing conditions.

g.title: Permanganate oxidative alkene cleavage: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
g.desc: CH3CH(OH)CH(OH)CH3 + oxidant → 2 CH3CHO + reduced Mn / water. Further oxidation cleaves the C–C bond; the oxidation network is grouped, not claimed as one known elementary transition structure.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Further oxidation cleaves the C–C bond; the oxidation network is grouped, not claimed as one known elementary transition structure.

g.title: Permanganate oxidative alkene cleavage: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
g.desc: 2 CH3CHO + oxidant / water → 2 CH3CO2H. Aldehydes are oxidized further through hydrated/metal-bound species under these conditions.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Aldehydes are oxidized further through hydrated/metal-bound species under these conditions.
